newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P raises Asahi Glass outlook to stable.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises Asahi Glass outlook to stable.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday that it had raised its ratings outlook for Asahi Glass Co Ltd to stable from negative.
S&P also said in a statement that it had affirmed Asahi Glass's A+ long-term rating and A-1 commercial paper rating.
The A-1 commercial paper ratings of two Asahi Glass units, Asahi Glass America USA Inc and AGA Capital Inc, had also been affirmed, S&P said.
The upward revision in the firm's rating outlook was due to expected growth in earnings and funds, S&P said.

"Improving business conditions will enable Asahi Glass to reap the benefits from the recent restructuring of its domestic operations and overseas expansion. As a result, earnings and funds from operations will grow, enabling the company to pare its debt leverage to an historically low level," S&P said.
